# SelfOrganizationDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The emergent, non-equilibrium process by which network topology reorganizes based on action-weighted path statistics, driven by local update rules. Offers a principled mechanism for neuromorphic systems to autonomously reconfigure connections, enhancing learning and fault tolerance in iNEST.
